mods.name: Only One Heart
mods.description: Limits players to one heart or half a heart and keeps the low-health HUD still.

releases.notes:
## Only One Heart 0.2.0

The first stable singleplayer release for Minecraft 26.2.

### Features
- One Heart mode
- Half Heart mode
- Off mode to restore vanilla health
- Removes the low-health heart bounce
- Absorption hearts from golden apples and other effects still work
- Mod Menu configuration
- `/ooh` commands for configuration without Mod Menu
- Config persists between sessions
- Supports Survival, Creative, Spectator and Hardcore

### Commands
- `/ooh`
- `/ooh status`
- `/ooh help`
- `/ooh mode one`
- `/ooh mode half`
- `/ooh mode off`

### Testing
Extensively tested in singleplayer. Dedicated multiplayer servers have not been tested yet.
